programs.desc: Captains Bobby Flay, Maneet Chauhan and Brooke Williamson lead their teams as they build a multi-component BBQ feast using only vertical fire, suspended proteins, open flames and zero safety nets.

programs.title: BBQ Brawl
programs.sub_title: Flay v. Chauhan v. Williamson -- Capital City 'Cue
programs.desc: Inspired by the live music scene in Austin, Texas, and led by team captains Bobby Flay, Maneet Chauhan and Brooke Williamson, the Brawlers must listen closely and hit all the right notes with their BBQ feasts.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri challenges the competitors to leave the plates behind and serve everything in a bowl; the returning champion takes on chefs Martel Stone and Evelyn Garcia to win over judges Antonia Lofaso and Aaron May in Flavortown's fiercest competition yet.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri cranks up the chaos as the returning champ faces off against chefs Hanna Haar and Gustavo Romero in a nut-fueled challenge; standing between them and victory are judges Lee Anne Wong and Eric Greenspan, who are ready to scrutinize every bite.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri is turning up the heat in Flavortown as the returning winner defends their title against Franklin Becker and Allison Fasano; the chefs must ignite the taste buds of judges Dale Talde and Claudette Zepeda with their spiciest dishes.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri kicks off Game Day as the reigning champ faces Torrence Chef T Gregoire and Joe Flamm in tackling fan-favorite flavors; judges Marcel Vigneron and Marcus Samuelsson are calling the plays and only one chef can win up to $20,000.

programs.title: Chopped
programs.desc: The competitors create appetizers that include a central Asian bread and a sweet and sour treat, make a packaged product sing with sole in the entrée round and take on a dessert round featuring an Indian snack and a plethora of pastries.

programs.sub_title: Spin It to Win It: Battle 1
programs.desc: It's the biggest "Chopped" shakeup ever as a wheel of chance will determine the fate of 16 chefs; in the first battle, four talented chefs must take on baskets containing a glorious seafood product, an amphibious delicacy and a strange beverage.

programs.title: Chopped
programs.sub_title: Spin It to Win It: Battle 2
programs.desc: With 12 chefs left in the pool, only three will be selected by the wheel to attempt to topple a fierce returning champion; the appetizer round presents them with a funny cake and an unusual canned item while dessert starts out with a meaty pie.

programs.title: Chopped
programs.sub_title: Spin It to Win It: Battle 3
programs.desc: This competition is all about skill, speed and ingenuity, and only one chef will impress the judges enough to survive the chopping block.

programs.desc: With six left in the pool, three impatiently sidelined chefs finally get their chance at the stoves; after facing the wheel's unfamiliar ingredients, the chefs race to prove who can make the better dessert from a breakfast pastry and an Asian spice.
